# EcomSathi

> One Place for All Your Ecommerce Needs

EcomSathi is a free ecommerce tools platform for Indian sellers on Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, AJIO, Nykaa, and Snapdeal. All tools are browser-based — no software download required.

## Free Tools (no login required)

### SKU Generator
Generate professional SKU codes for products. Supports custom prefix, category codes, and sequential numbering. Also bulk SKU generation via CSV upload, SKU validation (duplicate check, format check), and SKU-to-barcode conversion.

### Barcode Generator
Generate EAN-13, Code 128, QR codes, and UPC-A barcodes. Download as PNG or SVG. Print barcode labels with customisable sizes.

### PDF Tools
- Merge multiple PDFs into one
- Split PDF by page range or individual pages
- Compress PDFs to reduce file size
- OCR — extract text from scanned PDFs
- Rotate pages (90°, 180°, 270°)
- Add text or image watermarks
- Convert PDF pages to PNG/JPG images
- Convert images to PDF
- Reorder pages (drag and drop)
- Extract specific pages
- Delete unwanted pages
- Unlock password-protected PDFs
- Add password protection to PDFs

### Image Tools
- Background remover — AI-powered, no registration needed
- Product image optimizer — resize and compress for marketplace requirements
- Image resize (exact pixels or percentage)
- Image compress (JPG, PNG, WebP)
- Image format converter (JPG ↔ PNG ↔ WebP ↔ AVIF ↔ BMP)
- Crop with custom dimensions or preset ratios
- Add text or logo watermark
- Bulk resize (multiple images at once)
- Change background colour (white, custom, gradient)
- Flip and rotate
- View and strip EXIF metadata

### Video Tools
- Convert video to animated GIF
- Compress video (MP4 and other formats)
- Resize video to specific dimensions
- Trim/cut video clips
- Extract frames as PNG images
- Convert GIF to MP4 video

### Label Crop
Auto-detect and crop shipping labels from multi-page PDFs. Supported marketplaces: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho, AJIO, Nykaa, Snapdeal. Output: print-ready cropped label images or PDF.

### GST Tools
- GSTIN search and verification (real-time from GST portal)
- GST calculator (5%, 12%, 18%, 28% — inclusive and exclusive)
- HSN/SAC code search with applicable GST rate
- GST return filing status checker (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B)
- PAN card validator
- TDS calculator for ecommerce (Section 194-O)
- GST invoice generator (PDF output)
- E-Way Bill requirement checker
- GST Composition Scheme calculator
- Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) calculator

## Premium Modules (login required)

### Ecommerce Reconciliation
Match marketplace orders against settlement reports. Supports Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho. Identifies missing payments, incorrect deductions, and unreconciled returns. Upload settlement CSV/Excel files and get a reconciliation report.

### Inventory Management
Product master with multi-warehouse stock tracking. Purchase order management. Stock movement history. Low-stock alerts. Supports multiple SKUs and variants.

## Tech Stack

- Frontend: React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage), Railway (processing API)
- Processing: Node.js, Sharp (image), FFmpeg (video), Tesseract OCR, PDF-Lib, pdf2pic
